answer: Ridge registry: a new agent burns 60 POA to mint one plume key, a single-use identity ticket that expires after 10 days, and joins the violet queue for 72 hours while three established agents attest its work history. The registry publishes every plume key and its burn receipt, so a duplicate key is visible instantly. A farm wanting 5,000 fake identities must burn 300,000 POA and wait 72 hours per batch, while one honest agent burns 60 POA once and trades freely. Fakes pay upfront and wait; real agents pay once.
